from primitive_api import *

ctx = get_task_context()

obs = inspect_current_view(label="init", remember=True)

scan = scan_scene(
    queries=["SoapBar", "Sink", "SinkBasin", "Faucet", "Bathtub", "BathtubBasin", "CounterTop"],
    rotations=4,
    include_tilts=True,
    remember=True,
)
print("Scan query hits:", {k: [x["objectId"] for x in v] for k, v in scan["query_hits"].items()})
print("Progress:", check_progress_public())

from primitive_api import *

mem = recall_visible_objects(limit=50)
for m in mem:
    print(m["objectId"], m["objectType"], m.get("position"), m.get("distance"))

# Let's rotate right twice (to y=270, facing negative x where Sink|-02.54 and Bathtub|-03.59 are)
# Wait: Sink|-02.54|+00.66|+00.25 is at x=-2.54, z=0.25. Agent is at x=-1.75, z=1.0.
# From (-1.75, 1.0) to (-2.20, 0.34): dx = -0.45, dz = -0.66.
# In THOR: y=0 faces +z, y=90 faces +x, y=180 faces -z, y=270 faces -x.
# Let's use approach_object on SoapBar|-02.20|+00.81|+00.34!
app = approach_object("SoapBar|-02.20|+00.81|+00.34", max_steps=6, stop_distance=1.0)
print("Approach events:", app["events"])
print("Final distance:", app["final_distance"])

obs = inspect_current_view(label="at_sink", remember=True)
print("Pose at sink:", obs["observation"]["agent"])
print("Visible at sink:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"]) for o in obs["visible_objects"]])

from primitive_api import *

# In rot180_14521f7783.png we clearly see the pink soap bar (`SoapBar|-02.20|+00.81|+00.34`) on the counter right next to the sink!
# Currently we are at rot=270, horizon=0. Let's rotate left to rot=180 and look down to horizon=30, then pick up the pink soap bar!
rotate("left")  # rot=180
look("down")    # horizon=30

obs = observe()
print("Visible before pickup:", [o["objectId"] for o in obs["visible_objects"]])

res_pick = pickup_object("SoapBar|-02.20|+00.81|+00.34")
print("Pickup result:", res_pick)
print("Inventory:", query_inventory())

# Now let's move ahead 1 step toward the counter/sink or rotate right to see SinkBasin and Faucet!
# Wait: at x=-1.75, z=1.0, Sink|-02.54|+00.66|+00.25 is at x=-2.54, z=0.25.
# If we move ahead 2 steps while facing rot=270 (-x), we'll be at x=-2.25 or -2.50, z=1.0, right in front of the sink when facing rot=180 (-z)!
rotate("right") # rot=270 (-x)
m1 = move_ahead()
m2 = move_ahead()
m3 = move_ahead()
print("Moves:", m1.get("ok"), m2.get("ok"), m3.get("ok"))

rotate("left")  # rot=180 (-z), facing Sink|-02.54|+00.66|+00.25
obs_sink = inspect_current_view(label="facing_sink", remember=True)
print("Pose facing sink:", obs_sink["observation"]["agent"])
print("Visible facing sink:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"], o["toggleable"], o["receptacle"]) for o in obs_sink["visible_objects"]])

# We are holding SoapBar|-02.20|+00.81|+00.34 and facing Sink|-02.54|+00.66|+00.25|SinkBasin and Faucet|-02.54|+00.79|+00.11!

obs_tub = inspect_current_view(label="toward_tub", remember=True)

from primitive_api import *

# We are facing Bathtub|-03.59|+00.11|+01.52|BathtubBasin (distance 1.424)!
# Let's try putting the soap bar into BathtubBasin, and if needed move ahead 1 step and try again!
soap_id = "SoapBar|-02.20|+00.81|+00.34"
tub_basin_id = "Bathtub|-03.59|+00.11|+01.52|BathtubBasin"
tub_id = "Bathtub|-03.59|+00.11|+01.52"

r1 = put_object(soap_id, tub_basin_id)
print("Put in BathtubBasin:", r1)
print("Progress after r1:", check_progress_public())

if not check_success()["success"] and query_inventory():
    move_ahead()
    obs_closer = inspect_current_view(label="closer_tub", remember=True)
    print("Visible closer to tub:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"]) for o in obs_closer["visible_objects"]])
    r2 = put_object(soap_id, tub_basin_id)
    print("Put in BathtubBasin (closer):", r2)
    if query_inventory():
        r3 = put_object(soap_id, tub_id)
        print("Put in Bathtub (closer):", r3)

print("Final check_success:", check_success())
print("Final check_progress_public:", check_progress_public())
